spanish: Y ahora nuestra alma seca; no hay todo, sino al maná nuestros ojos.

findings.issue: «no hay todo» matches אין and כל word for word, but Spanish can read it as partial absence («not everything») rather than the negative existential over כל (there is not anything).

notes: Other tokens match in order, number, person, and definiteness; the verbless clauses add no unmarked copula.
